title: ee.preflight.guard.v1
description: Structured response emitted by `ee preflight check --cmd "<shell-command>" --json`. This is the agent-facing trauma-guard surface called by hook integrations BEFORE running shell commands that may delete files, rewrite Git history, mutate clusters, destroy infrastructure, or write raw block devices. Exit code 7 means policy denied: the harness should stop and ask the user for explicit authorization instead of retrying. Exit code 0 means no enforced match. The schema is intentionally NOT wrapped in the ee.response.v1 envelope — this is a hook-targeted surface; callers consume the structured guard result directly.

schema.description: Pins the schema identity. Treat any other value as a contract drift.

command.description: The exact command string passed to `--cmd` (or the positional COMMAND arg).

exitCode.description: Process exit code. 0 = no enforced match (the shell command may proceed). 7 = policy denied per AGENTS.md exit-code table; the harness MUST NOT retry.

checkedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which the guard ran.

repairCommandAssessment.description: Repair-action safety assessment for the exact command string. This classifier never executes the command; agents use it to decide whether to run directly, preflight first, coordinate, ask a human, or stop.

command.description: The classified repair command, or null for manual-only repairs.

preflightCommand.description: Concrete ee preflight check command to run before the repair command when present.

ruleId.description: Stable repair-safety rule id that selected nextAction.

reasonCode.description: Bounded explanation code suitable for logs.

ruleId.description: Stable identifier for the matched rule (e.g. core.filesystem:rm-rf-root-home).

pattern.description: Pattern that matched the command string.

action.description: How the rule classifies this match.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of why the rule fired.

source.description: Where this rule came from (built-in registry vs. user/workspace policy).

resolution.description: Final outcome for this rule. `enforced` means the rule will block the command.

matches.description: Rule matches with their resolution. Non-empty matches plus any resolution == 'enforced' results in exitCode 7.

memoryId.description: Stable memory ID of the matched record.

provenanceUri.description: Optional provenance URI for the matched memory.

severitySource.description: Where the severity was derived from.

matchedTerms.description: Terms from the command that matched memory content.

matchedMemories.description: High-severity risk, failure, anti-pattern memories that matched the command. Per AGENTS.md bd-3usjw.6, full memory-query coverage is still in progress; matchedMemories may be empty in the current build.

degraded.description: Degraded-mode signals from the guard run (e.g. memory-query backend unavailable).
